subject: website
name: elink.ubnet.eth (Havenly Home)
summary: Havenly Home, a room-decorating browser game. Its HTML, CSS and unminified app.js are served as written, so the page is its own public source (no licence file). It loads no third-party code and makes no request beyond its own files. Scoring, coins and designs run in the page and are saved in localStorage, with no server involved. Nothing it does shows the visitor to another party, so it is Level 4 with privacy.

operations.name: Place, move and arrange furniture
operations.note: Done in the page; no request is sent.

operations.name: Score a submitted room design
operations.note: Computed locally in app.js from the pieces placed.

operations.name: Buy items and claim the daily bonus
operations.note: Game coins only. The balance is kept in localStorage; no payment or server.
